objective: Evaluate the proposed LSDB 0.11.2 upgrade in the optional DR24 acquisition environment without changing the default dependency lock, source adapter, raw-data semantics, feature mapping, or frozen scientific baseline.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The PR changes the optional dr24 extra from lsdb==0.10.4 to lsdb==0.11.2. It does not change application source code.
The default lock excerpt contains FastAPI and Starlette pins but no LSDB pin. The standard CI dependency installation therefore does not establish compatibility of the optional dr24 extra.
Format and lint passed. The cumulative lifecycle gate failed because the PR had no cycle record. Test Suite, Runtime Smoke, package build and Dependency Audit were skipped.

DR24 HATS retrieval is bounded and source-native. Adapter behavior must preserve HMJD, mag, magerr, clrcoeff, catflags, OID, filter, and partition metadata. No feature normalization or model inference is implied by an LSDB upgrade.

baseline.description: The optional dr24 extra pins LSDB 0.10.4 and s3fs>=2026.9.0,<2027.0.0. The default requirements lock does not include LSDB.

change.scope: Add only a machine-readable lifecycle record for the proposed optional dependency update. No runtime adapter, data source, model, feature mapping, scientific threshold, benchmark, or release artifact is changed.
change.rationale: The lifecycle gate requires an auditable record. Because LSDB is an optional DR24 dependency and is not in the default lock, dedicated installation and bounded DR24 adapter tests are required.

expected_improvement: Make the optional DR24 dependency update auditable.
Enable required CI stages to run after lifecycle validation.
Verify LSDB 0.11.2 installs with the declared s3fs range and supports the bounded HATS catalog operations used by the project.

reliability.before: The optional DR24 extra pins LSDB 0.10.4. The standard CI lock does not test the LSDB extra.
reliability.after: The PR proposes LSDB 0.11.2. Compatibility remains unmeasured until the optional extra is installed and the bounded DR24 catalog/adapter tests run.

reproducibility.before: The PR had no machine-readable cycle record; the lifecycle gate rejected it.
reproducibility.after: A schema 1.1 cycle record is added. The next CI run must validate the record and run available engineering stages.

measurement.trade_off: The LSDB update may include upstream fixes, but it changes the HATS access dependency used by the optional DR24 feature. It requires bounded source/adapter evidence and must not trigger broad catalog scans.

evidence: PR #299 changes only the optional LSDB pin in pyproject.toml.
The default requirements.lock does not pin LSDB; normal locked CI alone cannot validate the optional DR24 extra.
CI #44721804229 passed Format and Lint, then stopped at the cycle-record requirement.
validation.blocker: Run CI after the cycle record is added. Install the dr24 extra explicitly, verify pip check and installed LSDB/s3fs versions, run deterministic DR24 adapter contract tests, and run the existing bounded live HATS parity test only in its opt-in workflow.

root_causes: The cumulative lifecycle gate rejected the PR because pyproject.toml changed without a JSON cycle record under configs/process/cycles/.
unresolved: The optional dependency change has not yet been tested in an environment that installs the dr24 extra.
LSDB 0.11.2 compatibility with the project's HATS catalog schema, objectid index query, and nested lightcurve payload has not yet been measured.

findings: A package's optional extra is not validated when CI installs only the default lock and omits that extra.
An LSDB upgrade must be tested against the exact catalog operations used by the adapter, not only package installation.
A successful dependency installation does not establish HATS data parity or scientific validity.

open_blockers: Complete current-head CI after the cycle record is added.
Install the optional dr24 extra and verify LSDB/s3fs dependency resolution.
Run deterministic adapter tests covering indexed lookup, nested payload decoding, epoch counts, schema, and provenance.
Run the pinned live HATS test as a bounded optional integration check.
Do not claim feature parity, model validity, or scientific acceptance from the dependency upgrade.

knowledge_carried_forward: This cycle records the proposal and CI blocker only. It does not accept LSDB 0.11.2.
Keep DR24 raw acquisition separate from normalized inference.
Preserve the frozen v0.2.0 model, 42-feature contract, taxonomy, class order, and benchmark.
Keep PR #299 open until the optional dr24 environment and bounded source adapter tests pass.
